method.additional_gate: horizontal scanline contiguous ink-run count; match either neighboring row within 1 px in both directions; reject 3 or more consecutive unmatched nonempty rows
method.reason: count persistent stroke additions or mergers rather than reusing one nearby stroke multiple times
method.calibration: trial parameters selected against requested counterexamples and retained rn/m reference; not human-validated confidence
limitations: short differences spanning at most 2 consecutive rows can pass
horizontal slices alone do not guarantee stroke identity
24px binary raster and bundled fonts only
